description: This file implements back-end APIs for the COSA Data Model Library related to bridging configuration, including creation, initialization, registration, and removal of bridge entities, as well as managing configuration data and associated sub-entries (ports, VLANs). It interacts with a registry system for configuration persistence and handles data structures representing bridges, ports, and VLANs.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaBridgingCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the COSA bridging object, initializes its function pointers, and calls its initialize method.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaBridgingInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the bridging object by setting up configuration data structures, loading existing entries from the registry, and populating internal lists with bridge, port, and VLAN entries.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaBridgingRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes and frees all bridge, port, and VLAN data structures, and cleans up the bridging object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaBridgingRegGetInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Reads existing bridging configuration entries from the registry into internal data structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaBridgingRegAddInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Adds a new bridge configuration entry into the registry, with optional upper-level hierarchy.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaBridgingRegDelInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Deletes a specific bridging configuration entry from the registry.

ctags.name: CosaBridgingRegAddInfo
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
